# recipes/el9/transactions.sh. Columns: scenario, expected dnf exit, expected
# outcome, exactly as transactions/scenario.sh classifies and summary.tsv
# Pinned from the deliberate release-transactions dispatch, run 30532825959
# (2026-07-30, cohort vinyl-9.0.1-ac4f719c16f4). THREE ROWS DIFFER FROM
# vmod-dict with dnf exit 0 where the identical scenarios refuse for the
# libvmod-* packages. The cause is libsolv name-order tie-breaking -- vmod-dict
# sorts after vinyl-cache, so the erasure is decided before dict's keep rule is
# reached -- and the maintainer adjudicated it pass-with-documented-exception
# future run refuses instead, that is a real behaviour change (a rename, a new
# dnf) and the pins move with it, in review.
